proposed_sites.reason: Module-level namespaced call openai.ChatCompletion.create(...) must become client.chat.completions.create(...) under the v1.x SDK; called from ask_chatgpt() which is itself invoked by process_message and process_voice_message.

considered_and_rejected.reason: The import itself does not need to change under the v1.x SDK (the openai module/package still exists and is imported the same way); only the usage sites (module-level namespaced calls, openai.error.* references, and openai.api_key/api_base/organization assignments) need edits.

This only reads an env var into a local Python variable; it is never assigned to openai.api_key or passed anywhere in this codebase, so there is no openai.api_key = ... assignment line to fix (the variable appears unused for auth purposes).
